cinematic.label: DEDICATED CAMP
cinematic.title:
YOUR GROUP.
YOUR PACE.
cinematic.tagline: You're 5, 10 or 20, with a shared goal. We organize a camp designed for your level and your dates.

hebergement.title: Block accommodation
hebergement.desc: Your group is housed together: adjacent rooms or dedicated building depending on size. You sleep and eat with your team, not with other parallel camps.

transferts.title: Group transfers
transferts.desc: One single MKR vehicle for the whole group at Makhachkala airport (Wrestling in Dagestan) or Grozny (MMA in Chechnya). No waiting, no scattered logistics.

programme.title: Level-adapted program
programme.desc: Coaching is tuned to the collective level (beginner, intermediate, advanced, mixed). No generic session pegged to the group average.

coach.title: Dedicated coach
coach.desc: A main MKR coach is assigned to your group for the full duration of the camp. You keep the same point of contact from first to last session.

tarif.title: Degressive rate per head
tarif.desc: The more of you there are, the lower the per-person rate. Trio tier at 5 ({trioPrice} / week / person), Club tier 6 to 10 ({clubPrice} / week / person), 11+ or full room on custom quote.

bilan.title: Group debrief
bilan.desc: Collective report at the end of camp and individual debrief for each member. You leave with a structured deliverable for what comes next.

steps.title: Quote request
steps.desc: You fill out the form: club name, number of participants (5 to 20), collective level, preferred dates, duration.

steps.title: Kickoff call
steps.desc: We set up a call with the group lead to frame the program, expectations, and logistics.

steps.title: Detailed quote
steps.desc: You receive a firm quote: rate per head times number of members, plus a breakdown of services.

steps.title: Approval and transfer
steps.desc: On quote signature, full group bank transfer to the MKR account. Visa invitation letters for each member.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.desc: 6-week physical prep program sent to each member. Everything is settled ahead of departure.

steps.title: Dedicated camp
steps.desc: Your group arrives together, lives together, trains together. Dedicated coach, adapted program.

sur_mesure.label: 1 TO 4 ADULTS
sur_mesure.title: Custom Camp
sur_mesure.desc: You're 1 to 4 adult friends? Custom Camp is the right funnel: your dates, duration of your choice.

sessions.label: OFFICIAL SESSIONS
sessions.title: 4 sessions per year
sessions.desc: Want to join a group put together by MKR? Four sessions a year timed with school holidays: Summer, Autumn, Winter and Spring.

famille.label: FAMILY
famille.title: Family Camp
famille.desc: Going with a child 8-17? Adapted parent and child program.
